I told Hollis the site is Gate 47, in a thread on his question in #central-team.

That comes from Pree's two messages in #central-team on the 14th. She first said Dock 23, then corrected it to Gate 47 the same morning because she'd read the wrong line. Hollis is in #central-team, so he can see both messages. My reply mentions the correction so he doesn't use the old Dock 23 if he scrolls back.

The site isn't in gbrain: a search for the Marrow Agrisupply inbound lane brought back the account page, contracts and tickets, but no dock or gate for the new lane.
